#### Check on Maggie's condition

**Paimon:** Are you alright?

**Columbina:** Maggie's hurt... but it's nothing life-threatening.

**Paimon:** Why's this happening... Aren't they supposed to be a couple?

**Columbina:** Is this what people call "a domestic dispute"?

**Paimon:** Where'd you even learn that phrase...? Anyway, we gotta stop that guy... You saw it all just now, right? Ungie's the exact same color as Eggie!

**Paimon:** The only difference is... he's huge! D'you think he ate a few too many Eggies, or something?

**Eggie:** Wait for me to... grow as big as him... Then I'll tell you, Paimon.

**Paimon:** Ugh... Oh, fine. So what do we do now? Should we fall back and wait for another chance now that Ungie's back?

- **Traveler:** There's no time for that.

**Columbina:** Yes... The Archaeolune Storm is closing in on Ungien's Circle, and there are many little creatures living there.

- **Traveler:** You take care of Maggie. We'll grab the Ancient Moon's Fount.

**Columbina:** Alright. But be careful.

**Columbina:** I need time to treat Maggie. Just keep Ungie busy until I get there.

**Columbina:** There are some small schools of kuuhenki living in the lunar sea. I'll ask them to help you out.

**Paimon:** Okay! Leave it to us!

**Eggie:** I'll... help too...

#### Talk to Paimon

**Paimon:** We finally got our hands on the Fount! That's mission accomplished, right?

**Eggie:** I sense... there's information I need in here...

**Paimon:** So you don't just absorb data from terminals? Because this looks like it formed naturally...

**Eggie:** No... it's artificial... I can feel it.

**Paimon:** O—oh... Be careful, then!

**Eggie:** Ahh... Just as I thought...

**Eggie:** This is an energy entity created by a researcher named... Lusalim...

- **Traveler:** Who's that?

**Eggie:** Ungien and Maagees' student... Likely also... the one who left the message in the terminal...

**Eggie:** This lunar sea... once used to be... Lusalim's Lunar Veil Laboratory.

**Paimon:** Lunar Veil Laboratory? What's that supposed to be?

**Eggie:** It's a... grand project meant to hide the moon.

**Paimon:** Hide the moon? Whoa, all these guys— err, all these dragons sure had big dreams! How did they plan to pull that off?

**Eggie:** The exact principles are unclear... but it seems to have something to do with his teacher, Ungien...

**Eggie:** Lusalim successfully experimented with a miniature Lunar Veil... by applying it to Ungien's Circle...

**Paimon:** Oh, Paimon remembers now! The Circle looked empty from the outside, but was completely different on the inside! So that was the Lunar Veil at work...

**Eggie:** That's right... The success of the miniature Veil... pushed the project on to the next phase...

**Eggie:** A massive Veil generator... was built here... One that could conceal the entire moon...

- **Traveler:** But the moon isn't hidden right now...

**Eggie:** That is because... before the Veil could take shape... an entity from beyond the stars pierced it.

**Eggie:** The device went haywire... the laboratory exploded... and all came to nothing...

**Eggie:** Only deep underground... might some traces still remain.

**Paimon:** Wait... a being from beyond the stars!? Could it be...?

- **Traveler:** The great ruler of the firmament...

**Eggie:** No one anticipated the entity's arrival. But it changed everything...

**Eggie:** Lusalim had designed... the Lunar Veil as a crucial part of Project Moongazer... but it had to be suspended...

**Paimon:** So what exactly is Project Moongazer?

**Columbina:** Look out!

**Paimon:** Oh no! Ungie's below us! Quick, get out of the way!

#### Repel Ungie

#### Repel Ungie

#### Repel Ungie

#### Talk to Eggie

**Paimon:** Whew... Ungie seems to have calmed down. So... were those vines the real culprits all along?

**Columbina:** He's still in pain, I can tell. His mind's been thrown into chaos, and he can't communicate with me.

**Eggie:** It's because of the information inside him... I can feel it...

**Eggie:** He and I... are of the same kind, after all...

**Paimon:** What are you doing, Eggie?

**Eggie:** His body... has information from Ungien's Circle within it.

**Eggie:** Do you remember how there were... Moonlight Vines growing near that terminal?

**Paimon:** You mean... he was the one who absorbed the information from there?

**Eggie:** Yes... that information... may contain details regarding Project Moongazer... That must be why I'm here.

**Paimon:** But you'll be putting yourself in too much danger!

**Columbina:** Paimon, let Ninnin go.

**Columbina:** She was born on the moon, and I was the one who, out of worry, sent her to a place thousands of miles away from home.

**Columbina:** She did everything possible to return here with your help, back to her homeland, all for the sake of her mission. That determination... It's remarkable.

**Columbina:** I don't think she wants to be protected, even if it's out of goodwill.

**Paimon:** But Columbina...

**Paimon:** Paimon's worried precisely because she's trying so hard... Y'know, even though she's hit her rebellious phase and hasn't shown Paimon any respect for a while now.

**Columbina:** And maturity is what follows that period of rebellion.

**Eggie:** Paimon... If you let me go... I'll respect you so much even the moon will seem less important by comparison...

**Paimon:** But this guy's huge! What if he swallows you!?

**Eggie:** If that happens... then that must also be part of my mission.

**Paimon:** You...! Ugh, how stubborn can you get?

**Columbina:** "Stubborn" is one way to put it. But you could also say that this is a wish she holds most dear.

**Eggie:** That's right!

**Columbina:** Then go, Ninnin. I have faith in you. Let this ray of moonlight bear witness to your choice and bless you on your journey.

**Paimon:** Eh? This is...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** I believe in you, too, Eggie.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I believe in you, too, Ninnin.

##### Shared continuation

**Eggie:** Thank you... Here I go...

**Eggie:** Ahh...

**Paimon:** C'mon, Eggie! You'll get through your rebellious phase, Paimon knows it!

**Eggie:** I can do... this...

**Eggie:** I... I did it...

**Columbina:** Looks like things aren't as bad as we feared.

**Paimon:** And thank goodness for that!

**Eggie:** Thank you... I've obtained some critical information. I know what transpired at Ungien's Ring and the Space Lifeform Capture Station...

**Columbina:** Alright. What happened? I'm curious too.

**Eggie:** It all comes back to that mysterious signal from deep space. It finally appeared again, many, many years after the dragon pioneer's passing...

**Eggie:** But even so, the Moongazer Tower he designed — the Eye of Ibni-Belum — captured the coordinates of that second signal.

**Paimon:** Wait, he finally did it? Awesome! So, where did the signal come from?

**Eggie:** From the depths of space, far, far away from the moon... So far away that the spaceship could barely reach it, and even then, it would lack sufficient energy to return.

**Eggie:** But Ungien, the life scientist, chose to pilot a spaceship named Moongazer and set out for those coordinates nonetheless.

**Paimon:** Wait, did he go cuckoo or something? Or was he not planning to come back?

**Eggie:** Perhaps it was enough for him that he'd be able to decipher the signal. And at that distance, he might have been able to transmit his discovery back...

**Columbina:** So, what happened?

**Eggie:** He disappeared into the sea of stars, and the dragons did not receive any messages from Moongazer thereafter.

**Paimon:** ...So he failed?

**Eggie:** No. Years later, the Space Lifeform Capture Station was suddenly rammed by an unknown object.

**Eggie:** After emergency repairs were complete, the researchers discovered that the object that had rammed the station was a cloaked spaceship.

**Paimon:** Cloaked... Like, invisible? Could it have been...

**Eggie:** Yes... It was the Moongazer. Though why it was cloaked is a mystery.

**Eggie:** Ungien's wife, Maagees, was the first to enter the spaceship, but she only found a round, black, spiky creature inside...

**Eggie:** Archaeolune spectrometers indicated that the creature... matched Ungien's data signature.

**Paimon:** Wh—What happened?

**Eggie:** Maagees ran a series of tests and thus discovered that her lover was fusing with some unknown creature.

**Paimon:** That's terrifying! Was it the mysterious space lifeform that had sent the signal? Did it eat Ungien? Could he still be saved!?

**Eggie:** Unfortunately, the dragon researchers had never encountered such a situation before. At a loss, they could only watch helplessly as Ungien transformed into an entirely new lifeform...

**Eggie:** Then, Ungien awoke, and he passed a message to them.

- **Traveler:** What was the message?

**Eggie:** There is no information about this.

**Paimon:** Ugh, seriously? There's still some missing intel?

**Paimon:** Hearing all this, Ungien had it super rough... He tried to capture an alien, but ended up getting caught himself!

**Eggie:** Hmm... That's not the case. The ship's log showed that the creature emitting the signal didn't attack Ungien. Instead, he was the one who chose to fuse with it...

**Eggie:** In this way, the creature was able to overcome the language barrier... and pass a message to the dragons...

**Columbina:** What a surprising turn of events... It seems that message may be the key to understanding Project Moongazer. I'm getting more curious about what it is by the moment.

- **Traveler:** Looks like we'll have to look elsewhere for that.

**Paimon:** So... Was Ungien still alive after all that?

**Eggie:** After delivering the message, Ungien began to die. But Maagees, being an expert in life sciences herself, used an experimental technique on him...

**Eggie:** One that could convert a lifeform into one composed of pure ancient moon energy.

**Paimon:** Oh! That sounds a lot like the dragons' phlogistonization!

**Columbina:** So, did she succeed?

**Eggie:** To an extent... She saved his body... and created Ungie, the first artificially-birthed kuuhenki on the moon.

**Eggie:** But Ungien's consciousness was completely lost during this process.

**Eggie:** From then on, she devoted all her energy to researching this new lifeform — until her own lifespan came to an end.

**Eggie:** Then she requested that her student Lusalim use the same technique on her, ultimately being converted into a new lifeform...

**Eggie:** Just as with Ungien, her consciousness was not preserved...

**Maggie:** ♪...

**Columbina:** So this is your story...

**Columbina:** If that's the case, I think that Lusalim may have been the one to inherit the message that the creature from space transmitted to the dragons.

**Columbina:** Did he also establish a research facility somewhere? That's most likely where we'll find the key to Project Moongazer.

- **Traveler:** I'm afraid his research facility no longer exists.

**Columbina:** Oh? Did you discover something?

You tell Columbina about Lusalim, the Lunar Veil project, and the Descender from beyond the skies.

**Columbina:** It was... destroyed by a Descender from beyond the heavens...?

**Columbina:** In that case, I fear the great ruler of the firmament is the likely culprit...

- **Traveler:** I had the same thought.

**Columbina:** A veil that could obscure the moon... That sounds very similar to the false sky.

**Paimon:** Yeah, like some sort of baby version!

**Paimon:** But his research institute has already been destroyed... He might've been lost in that explosion, too...

**Columbina:** My guess is just the opposite — that Lusalim didn't perish, and that his research survived.

**Paimon:** Huh? Why do you say that?

**Columbina:** As you can see, apart from the lunar sea itself, none of the draconic facilities have been destroyed. Not the Eye of Ibni-Belum, not Ungien's Circle, not the Space Lifeform Capture Station...

**Columbina:** Their survival doesn't seem in line with the plan laid down by the one who changed the world.

**Paimon:** So you're saying that Lusalim protected them somehow?

**Columbina:** Yes. He might've struck a bargain using the fruits of his research and followed the ruler of the heavens thereafter.

**Paimon:** That makes sense. And if it's true, he might've continued Project Moongazer elsewhere... But where?

**Columbina:** I do know of one other place on the moon. If Project Moongazer was hidden anywhere, my guess is that would be it.

**Columbina:** However...

**Columbina:** Ninnin... Is there something you haven't told us?

**Eggie:** ...Huh?

**Columbina:** Among your kind, only you have a mission you seek to fulfill.

**Paimon:** Oh, that's true! Now you mention it, Eggie's buddies all seem super carefree.

**Columbina:** Don't worry, I won't force you to answer. I just... want to know more about you.

**Columbina:** After all, out of all the terminals we've seen, not a single one seems to contain information about you.

**Eggie:** I... I don't know either...

**Columbina:** It's okay, I'm just curious. If you don't want to talk about it, you don't have to. We trust you.

**Eggie:** ...What if I really am hiding something from you?

**Eggie:** I'm just... curious, too.

**Columbina:** Hmm... Keeping secrets isn't always a bad thing. I learned that from a friend.

**Columbina:** But if I do get angry, I might take the hat I gave you back.

**Paimon:** And Paimon'll throw the snacks she was saving for you into the lunar sea!

**Eggie:** I understand. I promise I won't hide anything from you.

**Columbina:** Then I'll take your word for it, Ninnin. Now, please follow me.

**Columbina:** There's a base on the far side of the moon. My powers tell me that it's massive.

**Columbina:** I originally planned to save it for last, because cleaning it up would probably be exhausting.

**Columbina:** But now, I suppose it has to be moved up the schedule. I have a feeling we'll find the answers to our remaining questions there.

**Eggie:** Thank you. I... How can I repay you for all this?

**Columbina:** Look, Paimon, don't you think Ninnin's matured even more now?

**Paimon:** You're right... She's actually talking about paying us back! But we're friends, so there's no need for all that!

**Columbina:** Yes. He taught me that lesson, actually. You could stand to learn it, too, Ninnin. / Yes. She taught me that lesson, actually. You could stand to learn it, too, Ninnin.

- **Traveler:** It was, and would be, my honor.

**Columbina:** Well then, follow me when you're ready.

You catch sight of Columbina in the distance on a deserted island on the east side of Piramida. Worried that your friend has encountered trouble, you chase after her, and in so doing, embark on an adventure into the unknown...

#### Now in transit...

- **Traveler:** (Right, there was an accident on board the spaceship... We got into the escape pods... Did we make moonfall successfully?)

- **Traveler:** (It seems like I'm still in my escape pod... I need to make sure Paimon's alright...)

#### Talk to Paimon

**Paimon:** Ohhh, Paimon just knew you'd be okay!

- **Traveler:** How are you feeling, Paimon?

**Paimon:** Not good at all! When Paimon came out of her escape pod, you two were gone... Paimon was scared half to death!

**Paimon:** It's all good now that she's found you, though! Hehe.

**Paimon:** Now then, let Paimon give you a quick once-over! Are you hurt or anything?

- **Traveler:** Don't worry, I'm fine.

**Paimon:** Well, that's a relief! Who could have imagined that ancient ship would run into problems... Wait, no, we totally should've seen this coming...

**Paimon:** It was buried underground for who knows how many years, after all. It's a miracle that bucket of bolts could even fly!

**Paimon:** Whew... Whatever. The ride was kinda awful... but we still made moonfall in the end...

- **Traveler:** That's dragon-tech for you.

**Paimon:** Paimon blames Eggie for distracting us! We totally neglected to give the spaceship a good looking over.

**Paimon:** Speaking of Eggie... Where is she? Paimon remembers she got into an escape pod, too.

- **Traveler:** We have to find her.

**Paimon:** Yeah. Paimon hopes she's okay!

**Paimon:** Eggie! We're here to rescue you!

**Eggie:** ...Let me go...

**Paimon:** Hey! Eggie, wake up! It's us!

**Eggie:** ...You... Let go of me...

**Paimon:** Snap out of it! We're here to rescue you! You're safe now!

**Eggie:** Oh...! Oh... I'm sorry... It's you...

**Paimon:** How did you get captured by those things? Do you know what this place is?

**Eggie:** ...I don't know... but...

**Eggie:** ...Please let me... access the terminal...

**Paimon:** Terminal? What's that?

#### Activate the terminal

**Paimon:** Is this the terminal you were talking about, Eggie?

**Eggie:** Yes...

**Eggie:** Ahh...

- **Traveler:** Are you alright?

**Eggie:** Nin... Nin...

**Paimon:** Sorry, what?

**Eggie:** My name...

**Paimon:** So the terminal's got your name in it? And you're called Ninnin?

**Eggie:** The moons' power... can record... information...

**Eggie:** It is... stored in the terminal...

**Paimon:** Ah! So you can read the information in the terminal? Then, you know what this place is?

**Eggie:** It's an energy generation station... used to produce... and store energy...

**Paimon:** So those glowing orbs from earlier must have been some sorta energy, right?

**Paimon:** You must've been taken away to be used as an energy source because you have the same power...

- **Traveler:** What is this energy generation station used for?

**Eggie:** To power... the Eye of Ibni-Belum...

**Paimon:** The Eye... of Ibni-Belum? What's that? Sounds kinda familiar.

- **Traveler:** It was one of the spaceship landing sites.

**Paimon:** The... Eye of Ibni-Belum? What's that supposed to be?

**Eggie:** Here are the engineering blueprints... let me show you...

**Eggie:** The tall tower in the middle... That is the Eye...

**Paimon:** Whoa, that's so cool! What about the three shorter towers? Are they energy generators?

**Eggie:** Yes... We're inside one of them right now...

- **Traveler:** What exactly does this Eye of Ibni-Belum do?

**Eggie:** The work logs record that... it is a lunar surface monitoring station... capable of monitoring the entire lunar surface.

**Paimon:** Monitor the lunar surface? That's amazing!

**Paimon:** Then... doesn't that mean it could help us search for Columbina's whereabouts?

**Eggie:** I don't know... but... It's possible...

- **Traveler:** Looks like we're taking a trip over there then.

**Eggie:** We've already activated... this one...

**Paimon:** So that means we still have to deal with the other two, right? No problem! We've done this kind of thing tons of times.

**Paimon:** Come on, Eggie. Let's go!

**Eggie:** Not Eggie... I'm Ninnin...

**Paimon:** Eh, you can be both.

**Eggie:** Just Ninnin...

**Paimon:** Alright, alright, so you're Ninnin, aka Eggie. Does that work?

**Eggie:** I'm just Ninnin...

**Paimon:** Hey! Meet Paimon in the middle here, would ya!?

**Paimon:** Don't forget you got us stranded in this wasteland where there's not a single restaurant in sight... Do you still want your snacks or not!?

**Eggie:** ...

**Eggie:** Alright... I'm Ninnin, aka Eggie...

- **Traveler:** Sorry, what was that about snacks?

**Paimon:** Oh, uh, that's between Paimon and Ninnin!

**Paimon:** C'mon! We need to head to the other stations!

**Paimon:** This terminal's been left out here all by itself... Poor thing.

**Paimon:** Is it the energy generation station's terminal? Why don't you give it a try, Eggie?

**Eggie:** Hmm...

**Paimon:** How's it looking? Any new intel?

**Eggie:** This is the energy generation station terminal... but... I retrieved no new information...

**Paimon:** Hmm... Even though we didn't find any new intel, we still managed to activate station number two. Paimon would say that's a job well done!

**Eggie:** Wait... Signal locator malfunction detected... Energy cannot be transmitted to the Eye of Ibni-Belum.

**Paimon:** Success! Well, that was easier than Paimon expected.

**Paimon:** But we still need to activate the third station, right?

**Eggie:** Look... It's already active.

**Paimon:** Whoa, you're right... It still works, after all this time? Dragon tech sure is reliable...

- **Traveler:** Someone else might have activated it...

**Paimon:** Someone else? You mean... Columbina? After all, who else could it be... But why did she only activate one?

**Paimon:** You don't think... she found out something was wrong? Are we gonna run into some sort of problem?

**Paimon:** Hey... Eggie, you're not misleading us again, are you? This one's coming out of your friendship level!

**Eggie:** I don't know... what my mission is...

**Eggie:** But I'm sure it doesn't include... raising anyone's friendship levels...

**Paimon:** Huh!? Eggie, you've changed! Did all that info from the terminals go to your head?

- **Traveler:** Let's check out the Eye of Ibni-Belum first, shall we?

**Eggie:** Hmm... Traveler... more rational... reliable... good thinker... a superior partner... unlike Paimon...

**Eggie:** Let's go... Traveler... I'll walk with you...

**Paimon:** Huh!? Okay, that's it! Paimon's deducting another ten percent from your share of the snacks!

#### Activate The Eye of Ibni-Belum

#### Talk to Eggie

**Paimon:** So this is the Eye of Ibni-Belum? It definitely feels like a special place...

**Paimon:** Oh! The terminal's over there.

**Eggie:** I think... I'll get some useful information.

**Paimon:** Hmph, let's hope it doesn't puff your head up even more.

**Paimon:** Wh—What just happened?

**Eggie:** I activated... the Eye of Ibni-Belum...

**Paimon:** Oh? Did it work? Can you find Columbina?

**Eggie:** Hmm... in the facility known as Ungien's Circle... the terminal has detected...

**Eggie:** ...The appearance of an unknown individual lacking an identification code...

**Paimon:** Could that be Columbina?

**Eggie:** The system cannot confirm this person's identity...

- **Traveler:** Looks like we have to check it out in person.

**Paimon:** Hmm... We can't be totally sure, but at least we have a lead for now... So, how are we gonna get there?

**Eggie:** Let me help... Look... we can use this to get across...

**Paimon:** Wow! What is this?

**Eggie:** It's the entrance to the high-speed transit lane... it runs on the ancient moons' power...

**Eggie:** Through it... you can reach the next stop from the Eye of Ibni-Belum... Ungien's Circle...

**Eggie:** The terminal records state that... many species of creatures live there... it is a home for living beings...

**Paimon:** So, there are all kinds of creatures living on the moon? That's incredible...

**Paimon:** Should we head out now?

**Eggie:** Please wait a moment... Something in the terminal is still responding to me...

**Eggie:** Ah!

**Paimon:** Eggie, what's wrong!?

**Eggie:** There is a hidden module... "Project Moongazer"... It responded to me...

- **Traveler:** Any new intel?

**Eggie:** The module... records the origins of this tower...

**Eggie:** It starts with a dragon pioneer named Ibni(the first Moongazer)-Belum...

**Eggie:** The lunar vessel we traveled in... was his creation... He was the one who led dragon researchers to the moon...

**Paimon:** W—Wow, that's amazing! So this place must've been built to commemorate him, right?

**Eggie:** Not exactly... The terminal recorded this instead...

**Eggie:** After the pioneer landed... he began to explore the moon and circumlunar zone...

**Eggie:** Then, one day... while in the circumlunar zone, he received a... mysterious signal from deep space...

**Paimon:** A signal from deep space? What was it?

**Eggie:** The researchers couldn't decipher the signal's meaning...

**Eggie:** But the pioneer believed... it was a message sent back... by their king who had journeyed out into the sea of stars...

**Eggie:** And that king's name... was Nibelung.

**Paimon:** Th—The Dragon King!? Did the signal really come from him?

**Eggie:** I don't know... because the researchers could not enter deep space...

**Eggie:** So... they built this tower...

**Eggie:** This place, the Eye... It was originally a deep-space signal transceiver station... built to recapture that signal...

- **Traveler:** And... did they succeed?

**Eggie:** Many years went by... the pioneer passed away... but the signal never appeared again...

**Eggie:** His students gave up years later... and turned to more practical pursuits.

**Eggie:** They renovated the Eye into a lunar surface monitoring station... to make it easier for them to conduct more practical lunar research...

**Paimon:** Aww, what a shame... Wow, Paimon feels like we just stumbled on something super important...

- **Traveler:** And this is "Project Moongazer"?

**Eggie:** No... these are just the log entries I read...

**Eggie:** The real project file is encrypted... I can't open it...

**Paimon:** Huh? Didn't you say it responded to you? Shouldn't you be able to, y'know, open it?

**Eggie:** My data matches it... but maybe because... it isn't enough...

**Paimon:** Err, sorry, what do you mean by "isn't enough"!?

**Eggie:** It's like how... snacks and Paimon are a match... but twenty percent of the snacks won't be enough for Paimon to eat.

**Paimon:** Hey, you're the one who gets twenty percent. Paimon's getting eighty!

- **Traveler:** Sounds like Eggie is a key mold of sorts.

- **Traveler:** Some content is missing, so a key can't be forged.

**Paimon:** Hmm... Yeah, Paimon feels like that's exactly it! Come to think of it, could this "Project Moongazer" be connected to Eggie's mission?

**Paimon:** It responded to Eggie's message. In fact, it feels almost like it was waiting for her to show up!

**Eggie:** I don't know... but I want to... open it...

**Paimon:** Then let us help you!

**Paimon:** If there's not enough information, then we just need to go find more terminals, right?
